fact: The Planning Minister said the Startup Charter contains more than 80 policies and measures under implementation, including a low income tax and exemptions for startups with revenue under EGP 20 million and a deferred first tax audit of five years.
title: ميثاق الشركات الناشئة: سياسات وإجراءات مستمرة لتحسين بيئة الأعمال للشركات الناشئة في مصر
